settings.heading: Foam, not filling.
settings.body:
A lot of dog beds are filled with loose fibre or shredded offcuts. They feel plump in the shop and are flat by March, at which point your dog is sleeping on the floor with a cover over it.

Our orthopaedic beds are built on foam instead. On many, memory foam on top contours to hip and shoulder while a profiled egg-crate layer underneath spreads their weight, so it doesn't compress to the floor. Each bed's page says exactly how it's built, and the fibre-filled nest beds say so too.
settings.caption: A typical orthopaedic bed, top to bottom. Layers vary from bed to bed: each product page lists its own.

settings.question: How do I know which size to get?
settings.answer: Measure nose to base of tail while they're lying down, then add about 20cm. Between two sizes? Size up. Each size above shows its sleeping area, breeds and weight. Still unsure? Send us a photo of them asleep and we'll tell you.

settings.question: Is it too soft or too firm for an older dog?
settings.answer: Where we know a bed's feel, it's on the spec card from 1 (soft) to 5 (firm). Older, stiffer dogs usually do best on medium to firm: soft enough to take the pressure off, firm enough to push up from. If you get it wrong, the [nights]-night trial covers it.

settings.question: Will it help a dog with arthritis or stiff hips?
settings.answer: A supportive bed spreads their weight so pressure isn't concentrated on hips, elbows and shoulders. But a bed is for comfort, not a treatment, and it won't replace veterinary care. What it can change is the surface they spend twelve to fourteen hours a day on.

settings.question: What if my dog just won't use it?
settings.answer: Then it comes back. Put it where they already sleep, with a blanket that smells of home on top, and give it time: some dogs take a fortnight. You've got [nights] nights. If it still isn't right, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund in full. It doesn't need to be unused. Full terms are in our [returns_policy].

settings.question: Will it flatten like the last one?
settings.answer: The memory foam core is guaranteed [years] years against losing its shape under normal home use. If it does, we replace it. Covers, zips, liners, bolsters and fibre are wearing parts and aren't included.

settings.question: Can I actually wash it?
settings.answer: The spec card above says whether the cover comes off and at what temperature, and whether there's a waterproof inner liner. Beds with a coated, waterproof cover are wiped clean instead, because detergent strips the coating.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: You'll see this bed's delivery dates above the button. Our own stock is dispatched in [dispatch] working days, then standard delivery takes [transit] working days, free on orders over £[threshold]. Express is £6.99. Tracking comes by email as soon as it's on its way.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: This bed ships from our partner warehouse, so it takes a little longer than our own stock. Delivery is free and tracked. Message us before you order and we'll tell you the expected date.

settings.question: Is it chew-proof?
settings.answer: No dog bed is, and we won't pretend otherwise. If your dog chews or digs at beds, message us before you order and we'll tell you which bed stands the best chance.
